goal:
Write a script that optimizes stellar-class prediction for balanced accuracy. Submit your best work.

The task: classify each astronomical observation as one of three stellar classes — GALAXY, STAR, or QSO (quasar). The target column is `class`.

Columns:
- id: row identifier (not a feature)
- alpha: right ascension angle (sky coordinate, degrees)
- delta: declination angle (sky coordinate, degrees)
- u, g, r, i, z: photometric magnitudes in the SDSS ultraviolet / green / red / near-infrared / infrared filters
- redshift: measured redshift
- spectral_type: categorical spectral classification
- galaxy_population: categorical (present in both train and test)
- class: the target (GALAXY / STAR / QSO), present only in the training data
